title: Service catalog
description: Schema for catalog/services.yaml. Validated by scripts/validate_catalog.py. The catalog is the only source of shell commands in the system, so its shape is checked rather than trusted.

version.description: Catalog format version. Bumping it is a breaking change for the intent schema builder.

shellCommand.description: A command run on an agent. Constrained because these strings are interpolated into a Jenkins config.xml; the generator additionally rejects shell metacharacters in interpolated values (BUILD_PROMPT 4.6.3).

identifier.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Used in Jenkins job names, which appear in URLs and on disk.

approx_seconds.description: A hint for the UI before build history exists. The plugin's estimator learns real durations from history and ignores this.

repo.description: Clone URL. Checked for reachability with `git ls-remote` by the validator.

agent_label.description: Must exist on jenkins-dev, or a generated job could never be scheduled. The validator checks this against the live controller when one is reachable.

deploy.description: Keyed by environment. `production` is deliberately not a permitted key: this project is scoped to staging only (rule 1.5).

allowed_environments.description: Only staging. `production` is rejected by the schema itself, so it cannot be enabled by editing the catalog alone.

extra_stages.description: Optional stages the intent schema offers as extra_stages (BUILD_PROMPT 4.5.2).
